descripcion_geo: Kingdom south of the Dead Sea and east of the Arabah, in the red mountains of Seir. Capital: Petra (Sela).
importancia_estrategica: Control of the Via Regia, trade route between Arabia and the Mediterranean.

historias.titulo: Esau and Jacob: the origin of the conflict
historias.descripcion: Esau, father of Edom, sells his birthright to Jacob for a plate of lentils; The conflict between the two prefigures that of their people.

historias.titulo: Edom denies the pass to Israel
historias.descripcion: When Israel requests passage through Edomite territory on the way to Canaan, Edom denies it with the threat of war.
The prophet Obadiah announces the total destruction of Edom for his rejoicing in the fall of Jerusalem.

personajes.descripcion: Son of Isaac; He sold his birthright and became the father of the Edomites.
Descendant of Edomites (Idumeans) converted to Judaism; king under Rome.
He pronounced the shortest oracle of the OT against the arrogance of Edom.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Town related to Israel but permanent enemy; His Idumean descendants ruled Judea under Herod.

judaismo.descripcion: Edom and Jacob represent the eternal conflict between brothers: 'I loved Jacob, but I hated Esau' (Mal 1:2-3).
judaismo.significado_teologico: Edom and Jacob represent the eternal conflict between brothers: 'I loved Jacob, but I hated Esau' (Mal 1:2-3).

cristianismo.descripcion: Paul quotes Malachi to illustrate God's sovereign election (Rom 9:13).
